thread:
anya: Quick heads-up, ran cross-region bring-up for Qwen-34B / Mistral-7B-v2 / Llama-2-13B. Found a kernel selector fallthrough on Qwen when using GQA+RoPE in APAC that doubles p99 compared to EU. Posting quick notes + logs below.

liam: Can you paste the failure log and what kernels were chosen?

anya: sure. baseline run: fp16, seq_dist ~ mostly 512/1k/2k. GPUs: h100-us-west1, h100-eu-central, mi250-apac1. Kernel selector printed: auto -> meta_gqa_rope_fallback -> generic_rope. In APAC it fell back to generic_rope for long contexts.

anya: ```
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] kernel_selector: model=Qwen-34B arch=transformer_gqa state=selected=meta_gqa_rope_fast
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] kernel_selector: region=apac1 driver=535.102 fallback=generic_rope reason="no optimized gqa kernel for Mi/Icelake"
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] perf: p50=38ms p99=250ms tok/s=210
```

perf-bot: New benchmark results uploaded: /benchstore/1876543210 (csv + flamegraphs). Summary: Qwen APAC p99 250ms, EU p99 120ms. Llama-2-13B APAC p99 95ms, Mistral-7B-v2 APAC p99 110ms.

zach: Was this fp16-only? any quant runs?

anya: Baseline fp16. I also ran q4a quick sweep — p50 unchanged, p99 still spikes in APAC, and q4a shows +0.8% ppl on Qwen. Numbers: Qwen h100-us-west p50=35ms p99=120ms tps=220; h100-apac p50=38ms p99=250ms tps=210. Llama-13B p50=28ms p99=95ms tps=300.

rachel: Sounds like kernel selection + driver combo. APAC infra uses driver 535 vs EU 545 which has a patch for fused_gqa_rope. Could be missing optimized kernel for the Mi/older stack. Try forcing kernel override to meta_gqa_rope_fast.

liam: How reproducible is this with fixed seq-len (e.g., all 1024) and warmed KV cache?

anya: Repro is 90%. With warmup (5prefixes) p99 drops ~10% but still 2x EU when fallback happens. Seq-len 1024 p99 APAC=210ms vs EU=100ms.

rachel: Quick mitigation: env override: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=meta_gqa_rope_fast` and driver upgrade to 545. Command we used:

anya: ```bash
REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=meta_gqa_rope_fast ./bin/redwood-infer --model qwen-34b --seq-len 1024 --dtype fp16 --bench 1000
```

infra-bot: Job queued: repro-kernel-override-1876543210 (id=32021). Will run on apac1/h100 with driver=545 image. ETA ~ 30m.

zach: I'll start a kernel-selector bisect if infra reproduces. Might need a selector mapping config change so APAC nodes prefer the fused GQA kernel for Qwen variants.

perf-bot: Quick perf note: quant4a sweep logged: q4a vs fp16 (Qwen): p50 ~ same, p99 +15% when fallback kernel used, overall ppl +0.8. Mistral shows better q4a stability (+0.5% ppl).

liam: Can you attach the prompt set used for the bench? need to run our eval harness too.

anya: attached short sample (3 prompts):
- "Summarize the following legal contract in plain English..."
- "Write a 200 token product spec from bullet list: ..."
- "Answer multi-turn chat: user asks clarifying Q about code snippet..."

rachel: If override fixes it, plan: 1) hotfix mapping on APAC Dedicated pool, 2) driver upgrade schedule, 3) longer-term kernel landing with selector rule. I'll owners this in rollout backlog. :thumbsup:

zach: If we need a runtime patch, tag me and I'll coordinate with runtime eng. Might also be worth adding a quick detection in selector to log when fallback occurs and which kernel would have been ideal.

anya: thanks all — will update when infra job finishes (job=32021). Posting flamegraphs next.

infra-bot: Job 32021 completed: meta_gqa_rope_fast override reduced APAC p99 from 250ms -> 115ms. Artifacts: /benchstore/1876543210/override_run.tar.gz

liam: Nice. Can we run a 24h soak on Dedicated apac to ensure no regressions?

rachel: Scheduling canary now, adding to Dedicated apac1 queue.

anya: closing thread for now, will follow up with PR links and selectors mapping.
